name: Nyctosaurus
sum: Crested nyctosaurid from the Niobrara chalk of Kansas; mature individuals bore an enormous antler-like crest, and the hand lacked grasping claws.
wsnote: Adults a little over 2 m; some estimates reach 2.9 m.
holotype: YPM 1178 — Smoky Hill Chalk, Niobrara Formation, Kansas.
material: Several skeletons, including UNSM 93000 (most complete) and crested specimens KJ1 and KJ2.
exceptional: Crest of mature animals much larger than the skull.
biology: An ocean-going soarer over the Western Interior Seaway; probably caught fish at sea.
